permissive.description: If enabled, run in permissive mode (log but do not enforce violations). Disable for strict enforcement.

log_violations.description: Whether to log policy violations to syslog in addition to the audit log.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent session tracking entries allowed. Increase for high-concurrency systems.

bypass_types.description: List of SELinux types that may bypass session enforcement. Use with caution.

items.description: A single SELinux type to exempt from session enforcement.

exempt_users.description: List of Unix users (by username) exempted from session enforcement.

items.description: A single Unix username to exempt.

enforcement_state_file.description: Path to the file storing SELinux enforcement state (used by external tools and scripts).

audit_prefix.description: Custom prefix for audit log messages (e.g., 'sepermit:' or 'custom-sep:'). Leave empty to use default.
